source_registry.snapshot_type: public reviewed guide; checklist statuses belong to separate 01_DUE_DILIGENCE tab

priority_explanation.STOP: Material blocker: do not pay until resolved

items.question: Verify original Lalpurja and current Shresta match the seller, parcel, share and area.
items.evidence_required: Current certified Land Revenue Office ownership extract; original ID
items.stop_signal: Seller not the recorded owner or share cannot be conveyed

items.question: Check Rokka, mortgage, court attachment, tenancy/Mohi and pending disputes.
items.evidence_required: Written current restrictions and encumbrance check
items.stop_signal: Unreleased hold, contested ownership or undisclosed tenure

items.question: Confirm all heirs, co-owners, spouses or authorized signatories required to sell.
items.evidence_required: Consent, partition/inheritance papers or valid power of attorney
items.verifying_authority: Land lawyer and Land Revenue Office
items.stop_signal: Agent alone offers land without proved power to transfer

items.question: Obtain tax clearance and have a property lawyer review the deed and transfer sequence.
items.evidence_required: Tax receipt, draft deed, registration checklist
items.stop_signal: Large payment demanded before official registration

items.question: Obtain certified cadastral/tracing map, Kitta and field book or plot register.
items.evidence_required: Mero Kitta / Napi copies tied to same parcel
items.stop_signal: Plot on map differs from Lalpurja or seller's outlined land

items.question: Commission boundary demarcation and survey actual area, shape and frontage.
items.evidence_required: Measured boundaries with licensed surveyor and neighbor acknowledgement
items.stop_signal: Physical overlap, encroachment or unexplained shortage

items.question: Reconcile Lalpurja, field book, survey result and road deduction before paying by area.
items.evidence_required: Four-record area reconciliation and buildable area sketch
items.stop_signal: Unresolved area mismatch or only a hand-drawn Google outline

items.question: Confirm actual rural municipality, ward and land-use class from the parcel record.
items.evidence_required: Written jurisdiction and classification response
items.stop_signal: Agricultural/restricted land proposed as freely buildable

items.question: Check whether a residential villa/cottage may get Naksa Pass and required setbacks.
items.evidence_required: Written development control and permit feasibility
items.stop_signal: Building cannot legally fit after setbacks or risk exclusions

items.question: Check subdivision limits, protected areas, public rights and future road widening.
items.evidence_required: Approved layout and zoning/road plan
items.stop_signal: Unapproved plotting or planned acquisition consumes buildable parcel

items.question: Trace the road continuously from public highway to the property and identify legal ownership.
items.evidence_required: Survey map and public road classification or registered easement
items.stop_signal: Access crosses private land without enforceable right

items.question: Measure actual approach and road frontage, turning radius and vehicle access.
items.evidence_required: Surveyed width, grade and turning/parking assessment
items.stop_signal: Emergency vehicle or construction delivery cannot reach site

items.question: Inspect the route during rain; check bridge, erosion and seasonal blockages.
items.evidence_required: Wet-season route record and road maintenance responsibility
items.stop_signal: Only dry-weather motorbike access despite villa/visitor plan

items.question: Verify water availability in February–April or another local driest period, not just monsoon.
items.evidence_required: Dry-season source capacity and reliability evidence
items.stop_signal: Water currently available only in rainy season

items.question: Check legal water-use rights and cost of pipe, pump, storage and filtration.
items.evidence_required: Written connection or source agreement and connection estimate
items.stop_signal: No lawful year-round water allocation

items.question: Ask nearby occupied houses about dry-season supply, outages and backup.
items.evidence_required: Independent neighbor interviews; daily supply estimates
items.stop_signal: Supplier story conflicts with repeated local shortage reports

items.question: Identify voltage and check the exact electric-line alignment and prescribed clearance.
items.evidence_required: Utility voltage/corridor assessment and marked survey offset
items.stop_signal: Building footprint or safe access conflicts with line corridor

items.question: Confirm transformer/capacity, new connection quotation and whether pole shifting is permitted.
items.evidence_required: Written NEA connection feasibility and cost
items.stop_signal: Connection depends on unapproved pole relocation

items.question: Get contour survey, gradient and usable building platform after setbacks.
items.evidence_required: Topographic survey and preliminary siting overlay
items.stop_signal: Severe slope or insufficient buildable area

items.question: Investigate landslide history, soil strength, earth movement and retaining-wall needs.
items.evidence_required: Site geotechnical/geological review; adjacent slope inspection
items.stop_signal: Active cracks, fresh slips or unstable fills

items.question: Map monsoon surface runoff, drains, gullies and lands above/below parcel.
items.evidence_required: Drainage flow sketch and rain inspection
items.stop_signal: Runoff from uphill land concentrated toward building site

items.question: Price retaining walls, terracing, erosion control, septic/soak-pit siting and excavation.
items.evidence_required: Independent provisional civil works estimate
items.stop_signal: Earthwork and drainage destroy expected savings

items.question: Determine whether the land below/next to the plot can lawfully be developed higher.
items.evidence_required: Adjacent parcel planning envelope and permitted height review
items.stop_signal: Neighbor could block the view and no protection exists

items.question: Check view corridor from the proposed finished-floor height, not only current ground level.
items.evidence_required: Sightline sections with surveyed neighbor levels
items.stop_signal: Expensive view premium based on an unprotected current view

items.question: Compare at least three recent nearby sold or documented comparable plots, not only asking prices.
items.evidence_required: Area-adjusted valuation and independent local discussions
items.stop_signal: Broker's rate far exceeds comparable documented transactions

items.question: Calculate total acquisition and build-enabling cost, not just price per ropani.
items.evidence_required: Price + tax/registration + broker + retaining + access + water + power
items.stop_signal: Total spend exceeds budget after unavoidable site works

items.question: Use written payment milestones, refundable conditions and official bank-transfer trail.
items.evidence_required: Signed conditional agreement and money receipts
items.stop_signal: Non-refundable advance before title, survey and permit checks

items.question: Decide private residence versus guest accommodation before paying for location premium.
items.evidence_required: Written intended use and legal-use feasibility
items.stop_signal: Assuming Airbnb operation automatically permitted

items.question: If tourism use is desired, verify lodging permits, fire/wastewater access and operational rules.
items.evidence_required: Local approvals and initial operations compliance list
items.stop_signal: Tourism assumptions unsupported by permits/services

items.question: Check access from Pokhara, weather-season demand, mobile internet and emergency services.
items.evidence_required: Travel test and utilities/coverage observation
items.verifying_authority: On-site inspection and independent market research
items.stop_signal: Remote scenic site cannot support desired use

caveat: This guide is non-authoritative until documents are checked by the competent offices and professionals. The published questions are not verified evidence, nor is a checked personal note a formal clearance.
